name: trellis
description: Remediate Trellis findings through its stable todo schema and repository checks.

interface.shortDescription: Remediate shared JavaScript and TypeScript policy findings.
interface.longDescription: Trellis turns its existing deterministic todo report into a bounded remediation workflow. It preserves repository-specific suppressions and treats warnings as human-judgment work.
defaultPrompt: Remediate the next Trellis rule group in this repository.
